notes.title: New version with new features!
notes.notes:
[h1]The first discount for the Curse of Blood is currently in progress！

Duration: From 2:00 on January 26th to 10:00 on February 9th in the United States!

Discount rate: -40%[/h1]

[h2]1. New Role Experience System[/h2]

The new version adds a character experience system. Simply put, players who use their characters in the game to engage in a series of game behaviors will be recorded and calculated as character experience at the end of the game settlement. As experience increases, the character's ability level will gradually increase, unlocking corresponding level abilities. The next time a player chooses this profession to enter the game, it will increase character attributes or initial items.

It should be noted that when there are still remaining resurrection attempts to exit the game early, there will be a lack of calculation of the character's winning or losing experience, and characters that have completely died will not exit. Please make sure to continue the game to the end！

In the game hall, click on "Character" to enter and view the character levels and corresponding abilities of all characters at the current level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308065/8175e6724cfb27158d5e9c6e52dea2c5a188d19c.png[/img]

After selecting a character to play the game, players will receive the character experience of that character during settlement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308065/612414dad4b2c9b8f6355498c1145a6e4f37cdc0.png[/img]

When selecting a character in the room, the character level can be displayed to all players in the room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308065/1f1dd9e899089b3b59301f66ca7cfacc30ba1037.png[/img]


2. Quick message prompt

In the new version, quick message communication has been added, allowing players to communicate without meeting and prompting other players to take the next action. Of course, be careful, as players from other factions can also use quick messages to mislead. In addition, the vampire camp has additional phrase prompts compared to the regular player camp, which can only be seen by the vampire camp. Vampire players can communicate in situations where it is inconvenient to directly open the microphone.
Sending too many shortcut phrases in a short period of time will disable the function for a period of time. Please communicate friendly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308065/77cf97c2e9d1fabe1974c6850713c170689eba87.png[/img]

Add shortcut phrase sending function, players can use the left 【 ALT 】 (customizable) to call up shortcut phrases, and click the left mouse button to confirm sending.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308065/54c4f289c62680cb4bb46b2f2c6149c2e20ab096.png[/img]

3. Hall redesign

A redesign has been made for the game hall, adding multiple perspectives that can be switched using the mouse scroll wheel!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308065/511cf775c0d03422fdc7efb0b9e44842b1680515.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308065/0e0297df8d4fbeaa3cd5129d32995df0d294765f.png[/img]

4. Increase damage number display

For the convenience of players in choosing strategies during battles, increase the display of damage numbers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308065/8009a533f69ebcd11aa632703d0cb6f9626b7b64.png[/img]

5. Camp related changes

Mage's orb no longer deals damage to evil factions
The spell ball attacks of Ghost Mages and Blood Mages will no longer cause damage to NPCs and players in the Evil faction.

3、 Bug repair

Fixed a bug that previously caused abnormal size of arrow branches
Fixed a bug that caused the background color of the skill UI for equipment to change with the camp, resulting in an increase in equipment

notes.title: Update announcement on December 12th
notes.notes:
Camp related changes

1. In the vampire camp skill "Bat Movement" state, pressing R can directly transform back into human form

2. Vampires can activate and deactivate their transformation skill, Vampire Descent, which will increase or decrease their health based on the current percentage of health

3. Vampires activate different numbers of "little devil statues" to reduce the maximum health of "Vampire Descent"

4. The Blood Castle area will add attribute bonuses to transformed vampires and their summoning items



Prop related modifications

1. The health of each ranged spell ball in the "Dead Wood Staff" and "Dead Bone Staff" is reduced

2. Bullet synthesis modification: saltpeter * 4+iron * 2=bullet * 2

3. Exorcist synthesis modification: Iron * 3+Holy Water * 1+Silver Mine Raw Stone * 1=Exorcist * 1

4. Exorcists have added a SAN effect, allowing doctors to recover an additional portion of their health by using them

5. Exorcists can relieve the sustained damage of preservatives



Map related changes

1. Monster Wendigo no longer produces firearm parts

2. The production of raw silver ore, iron, and saltpeter in silver mines has decreased

3. [Ammunition Box] increases [Silver Arrow] output

4. [Bloody Castle] Tomb area increased by [Hand of Salvation]




Convenience related changes

1. After the player's complete death (in elf form), player perspective will be activated.



Bug repair

Fixed a bug that previously caused vampires to be unaffected by sunlight after leaving the church frame

Fixed a bug that previously caused an error in the closing language during settlement in collaboration mode

notes.title: The Curse of Blood will be officially released on December 6th at 10:00 am
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44308065/7ce0e56a5497908110015ab36f7ae14f4978f135.png[/img]

Dear players,

Thank you for your continuous anticipation. Our game, "Curse of Blood," is about to enter the open beta! At this special moment, we are tremendously excited to embark on this adventure with you.

Open Beta Time: December 6th, 10:00 AM

This is a game of survival and betrayal. Ten adventurers set forth into corrupted lands to prevent the impending Blood Moon. The bad news is that there are werewolves and vampires among them...

Factional Confrontation: Randomly become a human, vampire, or werewolf, each faction with unique skills and strategies.
Transformation and Skills: Vampires and werewolf disciples can transform and gain more powerful skills in their disciple state.
Crafting and Exploration: Enhance your survival skills in adventures by crafting items and collecting resources.
Tactical Confrontation: Devise clever tactics, defeat enemies, seize opponents' supplies, and become the ultimate survivor.
Important Note:
This is the open beta version of our game, and we look forward to your valuable feedback to help us optimize the gaming experience.

Thank you for accompanying us along the way. Let's embark on the fantastical journey of "Curse of Blood" together!
